Taqwim

Prayer times, the Hijri calendar, the Qibla and astronomy, working offline.

A free app with no ads and no accounts, for Android, iPhone, iPad, Windows, macOS, Linux and the web.

What it does

  • Prayer times by the known calculation methods, with alerts and the Athan
  • Hijri, Gregorian and other calendars, and the Islamic occasions
  • The Qibla: locator, map, and 2-D and 3-D compasses
  • Nearby mosques with directions, and maps that work offline
  • The Moon and the crescent, eclipses, the seasons, the planets and the sky sphere
  • The Astronomical Calculator: year cycles, the Moon at a moment, the historical day
